programme.title: Arundhati
programme.desc: An idol from a temple in Kshetram is hidden in a forest to protect it from invaders. The Rayulu family tries hard to reinstate it back to the temple in order to complete an old ritual.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Hum Hai Champions
programme.desc: Mallika is blackmailed by a dangerous don to fall in love with his rival's son Panda and eventually murder him. However, Panda is already madly in love with her and does not see what is coming.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Agnivarsha
programme.desc: In a kingdom stricken with drought, two rival priests, Yavakri and Parvasu, try to appease the rain god, Indra. However, their efforts result in adultery, treachery.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Reindeer Pedicure: Deep dive into a rhino's mouth, then give pedicures to a group of reindeer, before taking an afternoon stroll with a vulture. (S5, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Office Nightmare. Simon makes a gruesome discovery in a shipping container after workers stumble on a black mamba. An office goes into lockdown when staff spot a green snake. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Death in the Dust: As the Ghost River disappears, thousands of animals stake their survival on rains that may never come. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Shark Men

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Poultry in motion: Dr Ben treats a duck with an injured foot, while Dr Erin helps a stray chicken find a forever home. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Mountains: No Country for Old Men star Josh Brolin narrates an intimate study of the incredible creatures that populate America's mountain ranges. Stunning documentary series. 7+ (1 of 4)

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Coasts: An astonishing look at the creatures that populate America's coasts, from Gentoo penguins and grizzly bears to giant squid. Narrated by Josh Brolin. 7+ (2 of 4)

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Swimmers Beware: The team investigates several bites involving one species - the bull shark. These attacks occurred around the world, but what links them together? 7+. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Worst Case Scenario: With all the emergency agencies involved in a simulated plane crash exercise, real problems place airport operations in jeopardy. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: At the Cow Wash: Dr Oakley discovers a cow with a nasty infection. At her clinic, therapy dog Gauge needs surgery on his eye. (S7, ep 12)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Stingray Stunner: Stuart the stingray soaks up some Florida sun in order to get back his colour and his groove. 7+ (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Monster Snakes
programme.desc: Meet the giant snakes with killer reputations. From anacondas to man-eating pythons, experts investigate some of the biggest and baddest serpents around the world.

programme.title: Shark Attacks: Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: Blood In The Water: A look at terrifying tales of shark attacks, including that of newlyweds Kristy and Denver, who were surfing with friends when a shark struck. Did they survive?

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Lost Colony Of Roanoke Island: Ruins excavated on Pitcairn Island shed light on a previously unknown civilization. The remains of a temple are found on the island of Euboea. 7+. (3 of 10)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Pressure Pile-Up: The police force Thord to rescue a truck that is blocking a tunnel. Bjoern is put in danger when vehicles pass close by as he rescues a truck. (S6, ep 5)

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Line of Fire: As Mombo burns, lioness Thata risks everything to save her pride, but it comes at a terrible price. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: The Snake Pit: Simon has his hands full with a black mamba that does will not be caught, a cobra hiding in a room of old sacks and a snake in a car! 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Goats Gone Wild: The fair's in town and Dr Pol is busier than ever making sure his clients have healthy cows, sheep and pigs to show. 7+. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Hug for a Pug: Join Dr Oakley as she treats an enormous bull with a split hoof, an aging elk, and her own family's pet pug. (S8, ep 21) 7+

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: Uncertainty of the Future: Alaska Natives race the ticking clock as a harsh winter threatens to unfurl. 16+. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Flu the Coop: Dr Brenda struggles to find out what is causing a dog to be so lethargic, as she learns from his owner that he might have been exposed to marijuana. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Tunnel of Love: As the sea lions rejoice over the long-awaited opening of Adventure Cove, a tiny loris and beloved iguana present strange mystery illnesses. (S5, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Monster Under the Bed: Snakecatchers Simon and Siouxsie race to the rescue when a huge black mamba is found in a child's bed. Later, a deadly spitting cobra turns on Siouxsie. (S4, ep 5)

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Rwanda: Blanketed by mists and bordered by jungles, Rwanda is a country cloaked in mystery. Here, discover great apes and some of the continent's most mysterious landscapes. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Shark Men
programme.desc: The Hot Spot: The crew's plans to catch a big shark are scuppered when a smaller male steals the bait. But this feisty young shark might prove a great catch after all. 7+ (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Dinner and a Moo-Vie: The vets visit a sick cat at an antique store which leads to some vintage finds. They also treat a hawk with a life-threatening injury. 7+ (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: Europe's Wild Places
programme.desc: Winter's Grip: Europe is covered in snow, forcing hardships on its winter wildlife including lynx, arctic foxes and wolves. Only the most resourceful can thrive. 7+ (S1, ep 1 of 2)

programme.title: Europe's Wild Places
programme.desc: Springtime Survival: Spring sees baby wildlife born across Europe, as parents teach and protect. Follow seal pups, geese, marmots and more as they strive to survive. (S1, ep 2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Killers in the Water: Diva uncovers a change in shark bites along the South African coast, before developing a unique experiment to test the sharks' countershading. 12+. (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Testing Times: A Labrador has his first day as a drug sniffer, the managers see if they can smuggle a fake bomb past their screening teams and Annie faces her moment of truth. (S1, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: The Big Bad Wolf: Dr Oakley and her daughters travel to the AWCC where they attempt to bond with a lone wolf. Plus, they give a bald eagle a much-needed mani and pedi. (S7, ep 13)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Tampa
programme.desc: Oh, The Hu-Manatee: The team welcome two manatees to the Zoo Tampa Manatee hospital, and say goodbye to chimpanzees Twiggy, Jamie and Nick. 7+ (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Pole To Pole With Will Smith

programme.title: Pole To Pole With Will Smith
